name: Autodraw
summary: Developed by Google, it turns simple doodles into professional-looking drawings using machine learning.
description: Developed by Google, it turns simple doodles into professional-looking drawings using machine learning. Fast drawing for everyone. AutoDraw pairs machine learning with drawings from talented artists to help you draw stuff fast. Doodle recognition: Turn rough sketches into clean illustrations. Icon suggestions: Instantly get matching icons as you draw. Cross-platform: Use on desktop and mobile browsers. Sketch library: Access a wide range of free-to-use images.

howToUse.title: Start Drawing
howToUse.description: Go to Autodraw and begin doodling with your mouse or touchscreen.

howToUse.title: View Icon Suggestions
howToUse.description: As you draw, suggested icons will appear above the canvas.

howToUse.title: Select and Refine
howToUse.description: Click on a suggested icon to replace your doodle with a professional-looking drawing.

howToUse.title: Download or Share
howToUse.description: Download your finished artwork or share it online.

features_fr: Reconnaissance des gribouillages : transformez des croquis grossiers en illustrations épurées.
Suggestions d'icônes : obtenez instantanément les icônes correspondantes lorsque tu dessinez.
Multiplateforme : utilisation sur les navigateurs de bureau et mobiles.
Bibliothèque de croquis : accédez à une large gamme d'images gratuites.
